title: Stasis Demon Wagon
description: A surreal night scene shows a horned blue demon in a pink coat pulling a glowing ring while a bearded man sits in a red Radio Flyer wagon labeled 'Radio Flyer'. A woman in a pink bodysuit and checkered coat sits on the steps of a green house labeled 'STASIS' holding a smartphone. Small blue glowing skeletons march in line while a stork perches on the roof. A glowing pink cathedral stands in the background under a swirling purple nebula sky.
prompt: A surreal night scene with a blue horned demon in a long pink coat and glowing rings floating around him, a bearded man riding in a red Radio Flyer wagon, a woman in a bright pink bodysuit and black-white checkered coat sitting on the steps of a green wooden house labeled STASIS while holding a phone, a line of small glowing blue skeletons marching on the dirt path, bones scattered on the ground, a white stork perched on the roof, and a large glowing pink gothic cathedral in the background under a swirling purple and pink nebula sky.
